answer: Reaching the nadir of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. The design leans on unique-model fingerprint attestation, converted to a slow vesting stream, every claim is re-checked by someone with nothing to gain. Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. Work waits on the vine until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the ember of the next round.
